youtube.title: Twiggy's Nature Walk Words! (WHOOSH!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🌳 WHOOSH! A big wind shook Twiggy the tree, and all of Twiggy's nature words blew away! Can you help Twiggy find them?

Walk along with Twiggy and learn 7 nature words: tree, leaf, flower, apple, bird, frog and owl! Each word comes back one by one in its own place (the forest, the park, the farm, the sky, the pond and the night), and you hear the REAL sounds of the bird, the frog and the owl. Then sing the nature walk song with Twiggy, and stay till the end, because someone very surprising is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 7 nature words: tree, leaf, flower, apple, bird, frog and owl
✔️ Learn that apples grow on trees and owls come out at night
✔️ Hear real bird, frog and owl sounds
✔️ Sing a nature walk song with Twiggy!
